description: This file defines the core Page class and related classes for managing browser pages in Playwright, including handling navigation, events, bindings, screenshots, and worker management.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: Represents a browser page, managing navigation, events, bindings, screenshots, workers, and lifecycle.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a web worker associated with a page, handling evaluation and lifecycle.

classes.name: PageBinding
classes.description: Manages bindings exposed to the page's JavaScript context.

classes.name: InitScript
classes.description: Represents an initialization script injected into the page or browser context.

methods.name: reportAsNew
methods.description: Marks the page as initialized, optionally with an opener page.

methods.name: _markInitialized
methods.description: Internal method to finalize page initialization.

methods.name: initializedOrUndefined
methods.description: Returns the page if initialized, otherwise undefined.

methods.name: waitForInitializedOrError
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the page is initialized or errors.

methods.name: emitOnContext
methods.description: Emits an event on the browser context.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Resets the page state for reuse.

methods.name: _didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the page is closed.

methods.name: _didCrash
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the page crashes.

methods.name: opener
methods.description: Returns the opener page, if any.

methods.name: mainFrame
methods.description: Returns the main frame of the page.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns all frames of the page.

methods.name: exposeBinding
methods.description: Exposes a function binding to the page.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets extra HTTP headers for the page.

methods.name: addNetworkRequest
methods.description: Adds a network request to the internal list.

methods.name: networkRequests
methods.description: Returns the list of network requests.

methods.name: onBindingCalled
methods.description: Handles a call from a page binding.

methods.name: consoleMessages
methods.description: Returns stored console messages, optionally filtered.

methods.name: pageErrors
methods.description: Returns stored page errors, optionally filtered.

methods.name: performActionPreChecks
methods.description: Performs pre-action checks like navigation and locator handling.

methods.name: setEmulatedSizeFromWindowOpen
methods.description: Sets emulated size from window open.

methods.name: _setEmulatedSize
methods.description: Internal method to set emulated size.

methods.name: needsRequestInterception
methods.description: Checks if request interception is needed.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the page is closed.

methods.name: hasCrashed
methods.description: Checks if the page has crashed.

methods.name: isClosedOrClosingOrCrashed
methods.description: Checks if the page is closed, closing, or crashed.

methods.name: fileChooserIntercepted
methods.description: Checks if file chooser is intercepted.

methods.name: frameNavigatedToNewDocument
methods.description: Handles navigation to a new document in a frame.

methods.name: safeNonStallingEvaluateInAllFrames
methods.description: Evaluates an expression in all frames safely.

methods.name: snapshotForAI
methods.description: Takes a snapshot for AI processing.
